subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the sentence given below.**

Most of the people say that __**some people fight for the cause but most of them don’t support it**.__

options.text: Are out of frying pan onto the fire
Spare the rod and spoil the child

solution:
The correct answer is **"Pay only lip service."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Pay only lip service"** means to express support or agreement with something verbally, but not actually take any action to support it. (मौखिक रूप से किसी बात पर समर्थन या सहमति व्यक्त करना, लेकिन वास्तव में इसके समर्थन में कोई कार्रवाई नहीं करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *My boss **pays only lip service**__ to work-life balance, but expects us to work overtime every day.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, it means that some people claim to fight for a cause, but don't actually support it.
 
• This idiom is often used in situations where someone is being insincere or hypocritical.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "Are out of frying pan onto the fire,"** means to go from a bad situation to an even worse one. (बुरी स्थिति से और भी बदतर स्थिति में जाना)
 
• **Option 2, "Spare the rod and spoil the child,"** means that if you don't discipline a child, they will become spoiled and misbehaved. (यदि आप किसी बच्चे को अनुशासित नहीं करेंगे, तो वे बिगड़ैल और दुर्व्यवहारी हो जायेंगे)
 
• **Option 4, "Mind their P's and Q's," **means to be careful and pay attention to details. (सावधान रहना और विवरणों पर ध्यान देंना)
